calls.thesis: BUY (first tracked for MarketBeat; guest Alec Green, Oxford Club) — MercadoLibre, the 'Amazon of Latin America', dominates LatAm e-commerce more than Amazon dominates the US; recent margin concerns are overdone because spend was for long-term growth; long-term uptrend intact and stock undervalued on forward sales/earnings. No price stated.
calls.bull_case: LatAm e-commerce penetration still early (smartphone/computer ownership lower, fragmented retail); sales and earnings growth ahead should drive sharp appreciation.
calls.bear_case: Margin pressure from long-term growth spending dented short-term results; holders over the past year are slightly underwater.

calls.video_title: Mercadolibre Stock Analysis: Buy, Hold, or Sell? | MELI Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated — he says he last rated MELI an attractive buy on 28 Aug and, after refreshing his DCF and the Brazil election developments, it looks 'even more attractive': $2,900 fair value vs $1,876, trading near its lowest forward P/E in years. First tracked Parkevtate MELI call in calls.json — no flip.
calls.base_case: Revenue up from ~$1B in 2017 to over $35B TTM, first $10B quarter in its history; the lowered free-shipping threshold is lifting purchase frequency, new customers and retention, and the financial services segment grew 75% YoY — the two segments fuel each other.
calls.bull_case: A more favourable Brazil election outcome addresses one of the bigger concerns against the stock; the very positive customer response to the free-shipping change builds longer-term value while the valuation sits at a multi-year low.
calls.bear_case: Operating margin has fallen from ~16% in 2023 to 8% TTM and ROIC has declined on the cost of the free-shipping policy; Brazil's political volatility and bureaucratic burden on businesses remain a risk.
